abstract: Navigating unfamiliar outdoor environments is one of the most demanding everyday tasks for people with visual impairments (PVI). However, existing navigation systems cannot simultaneously satisfy the needs of informative perception and precise localization during navigation. This paper explores the core navigation demands of PVI through a preliminary study. Based on the results of the pre-study, we present the design of InSight, a mobile assistant that combines scene descriptions with precise localization to support PVI navigating unfamiliar outdoor environments. The offline mode of InSight runs entirely on device for real-time navigation, while the online mode streams camera frames to a self-hosted server for arbitrary object detection and accurate localization. Finally, a user study with 21 visually impaired participants validates that InSight could assist users in navigating unfamiliar outdoor environments with increased success rate and confidence compared to mainstream navigation applications like Apple Maps.

ur.tldr: 针对视障人士在陌生户外环境中导航时难以同时获取环境信息与精确定位的问题，研究者先通过预研识别其核心需求，进而设计移动助手 InSight：离线模式在端侧实时运行场景描述，联机模式则将画面流式传输至自托管服务器执行任意目标检测与定位。21 名视障用户的对比实验表明，InSight 相较 Apple Maps 等主流导航应用，显著提升了导航成功率与用户信心。

title: InSight: A Mobile Assistant Helping Visually Impaired People Navigate Unfamiliar Environment
title_zh: InSight：帮助视障人士在陌生环境中导航的移动助手
